resources.string: Check for updates and view release notes
Check for a new version of MediaFlow.
A new version of MediaFlow is ready for you. Discover what’s new in this release.
Allow MediaFlow to install apps in Android settings, then return here to continue.
No new updates are available yet.
The update could not be completed. You can try again.
Could not connect to the update source. Check your connection and try again.
The update source is temporarily rate limited. Try again later.
The update information is invalid or its source could not be verified.
This update is not compatible with your device.
There is not enough free storage for the update.
The update download is incomplete. Try downloading it again.
The update file could not be verified. It was removed; try downloading it again.
The update does not match this app, its signing identity or the expected version.
Installation was cancelled. The verified update is ready to install later.

Android could not finish the installation. Keep your important files, check free space and installation permissions, then try again. If Android reports a conflict, check for another MediaFlow copy in your work profile or other users.

This file has a different signing identity and cannot update this copy. Download from the official website. For an old test build, keep your important files first, then remove that copy from each profile where you installed it before installing Production. Do not delete your work profile.

Android reported an app conflict. An old MediaFlow copy may remain in a work profile or another user. Keep important files first, then check Settings → Apps in each profile you control. Remove only the incompatible MediaFlow copy, not the profile, and install the official release again. A managed profile may require its administrator.
Android or your device administrator blocked installation. Allow MediaFlow to install updates in Android settings if permitted. For a managed device, ask its administrator.
Android rejected the installation file. Download a fresh copy from the official website and try again.
